name: Blackwall x402 Payment Gate
description: Pre-signature payment verdicts for x402, enforced at the runtime layer: a before_tool_call hook recognizes payment-shaped tool calls (flat payTo/amount, 402-challenge accepts[], or a signed X-PAYMENT header), asks Blackwall's /v1/forecast-payment for GO/HOLD/STOP, and blocks anything that is not a GO. Keyless; only the payment claim leaves the sandbox.

baseUrl.description: Blackwall deployment base URL. Defaults to the free public instance (https://blackwall-free.onrender.com); point at your own deployment for real workloads. Env: BLACKWALL_X402_URL.

mode.description: enforce (default): block non-GO verdicts. observe: log verdicts, never block. This hook fires only on payment-shaped calls, so enforce is the default on purpose. Env: BLACKWALL_X402_MODE.

failClosed.description: enforce mode: when the verdict service is unreachable, block the payment instead of signing unscored. Defaults to true; non-payment tool calls are never affected. Env: BLACKWALL_X402_FAIL_CLOSED.

payer.description: The agent's own wallet address; attached to claims so settlement confirmation binds to this agent. Env: BLACKWALL_PAYER.

paymentTools.description: Extra tool-name tokens (word-boundary matched) that mark a tool as payment-shaped, e.g. your wallet tool's name. Extends the defaults (x402, pay, payment, payto, usdc).

forecastTimeoutMs.description: Per-forecast timeout in ms. Default 60000 — generous because the free instance cold-starts after idle.
